title: CouponsResolveResult
description: coupons.resolve-result@1: the answer of GET /api/v1/merchants/resolve?host= on OpenVibe.Coupons (coupons.merchant.resolve; public, anonymous allowed, rate-limited, CORS for the configured extension origins): the merchant whose domain rule matches the host. No match is 404 merchant.not_found with the normalised host and its registrable domain; a missing host is 400 host.required.
